task: create a graphic design in a design tool (Canva, Adobe Express, Figma, Photoshop): start from a template or blank canvas toward a concrete artifact — a flyer, poster, invitation, social post, logo, or thumbnail — customize text, images, colors, and layout, and export or download it; complete when the export/download confirmation or the finished file is shown. Surface pinned: the design-tool session — not design-theory videos, not portfolio showcases. AI-generation flows (Canva Magic Design, text-to-image design generators) are off-task: the arc must be manual template or canvas editing.

tree.label: Create and export a design
tree.note: In most of the videos the user starts by opening the tool (1), and completes 1.3 before 2 when the design needs a file the tool cannot make. 2 fixes the canvas: a template, a blank size, or a page added to an existing file, and 2.7 again whenever the background is retuned. then the element loop: for each element the user adds it in 3, edits it in 4 or 5 depending on the kind of element, and positions and orders it in 6 - repeated for every element in whatever order the design needs, 15 to 40 times per keeper. 7 runs during and after the loop and sends the user back into 3, 4, 5 or 6. 8 only for a design that moves, after the static scene is laid out. 9 exports the file and 9.9 carries it to where it will be used. the task ends at 9.7, or with the finished canvas on screen - in four of the videos the user does not export the file, and three other recordings end before the file appears.

children.label: Start in the tool
children.note: 1.1 where the tool is a choice - one keeper compares two, the rest arrive decided. 1.2 always: the phone keepers find the app in the drawer, the web keepers search or log in. 1.3 before 2 when the design needs a frame, a cutout, or an asset pack the tool cannot produce. 1.4 whenever a price or plan wall appears, at any point in the task.
